page.layout: One column of running text (dictionary entries); page number top left, running head top centre; catchword "Fla-" at bottom right. Show-through from the facing page appears faintly in the background and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: In fine deficere] Ab ipsa messe discedere. In summo clivo deficere. In portu impingere. Devorato boye in cauda deficere.
Finem non assequi] Operam ludere. Operam & oleum perdere. Excidere fine, Quint.
Finitimus] Confinis, Plin. In confinio positus, Vlp. Conterminus, Col. Collimitatus, Salin. Affines potentioribus, Sallust.
Firmamentum] Firmamen trunci, Ovid. Stabilimen regni, Cic. Stabilimentum, Plaut. Duramentum virtutis necessitas, Sen. Solidamentum, Lactant. Statuminatio, Vitruv.

Firmare] Clavo trabali figere. Corroborare, Cic. Stabilire, Plaut. Roborare. Rigorare. Statuminare, Plin. Consolidare, Vlp. Affirmare armis virtutem alicujus, Tac. Confirmare. Constabilire rem, Ter. Indurare, Sen. Fundare, Virg.
Firmè] Valenter. Firmiter, Col. Prævalidè, Plin. Nervosè. Clavo trabali figere, Cic. Omni pede stare, Quint.
Firmitas] Firmitudo animi. Soliditas. Stabilitas. Nervus, Cic.

Firmus] Fixus. Stabilis. Defixus altissimis radicibus. Nunquam dimoveri loco potest. Labefactari non potest, Cic. Infrangibilis rigor animi, Sen. Infrangibilis animus, Ovid. Potens argumentum, Quint. Vid. Immobilis. Robustus.
Fissura] Fissus,ûs. Vitium ædis, parietis, Cic. Fissum, Celf. Scissura, Rima, Plin. Segmen & rima parietis, Vitruv. Spiramentum, Virg.
Fistucare] Fistucis pavire, Plin. Fistucationibus solidare, Vitr. Fistucis fustibusque calcare, Cat. Pavire, Pavimentare, Circumpavire, Plin. Configere locum congestitium, Vitr.
Fistucatus] Pavitus, Glutus, Subactus, Plin. Glittus, Fest. Pavidatum solum rudere, Pallad. Occulcatus, Varr. Palatum.

page.notes: Faint marginal ink and show-through in the margins; the entry "Fistucatus" line 2 and "Pavidatum" are partly obscured, and the word after "Fest." is read as the likely "Pavidatum" with [?] not applied as the scan is clear enough. Catchword "Fla-" read at lower right.
